layout_description: Vertical 1080 × 1920 Amazon main image on pure white background. Center the ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 as the dominant object, filling approximately 85% of the frame while keeping the entire product visible. Show the dashcam in a clean three-quarter product angle that clearly communicates it is a compact black dash camera, with the driver-facing screen, road-facing lens, lower cylindrical camera housing, top mounting plate, side circular control area, and orange accent detail visible. Arrange included accessories only if space allows without reducing product dominance: Anker 2-Port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner's Manual placed neatly below or beside the main dashcam.
visual_design_direction: Professional Amazon-compliant studio product photography. Pure white RGB 255,255,255 background, realistic matte black plastic texture, glossy trim reflections, glass lens shine, subtle screen gloss, orange side accent, and soft minimal grounding shadows. No lifestyle environment, no vehicle interior, no props, no decorative elements, no badges, no callouts, no icons, and no added text or graphics.
image_generation_prompt: Create a realistic Amazon hero product image in vertical 9:16 format, 1080 × 1920 pixels. Use the attached reference product images to accurately depict the ROAV by ANKER DASHCAM C1, model R2110, in black. The main object is a compact dash camera with a rounded-rectangle matte black plastic body, glossy black trim, a driver-facing illuminated 2.4 inch screen, a road-facing protruding circular glass lens, a horizontal lower cylindrical camera housing, a large top mounting plate with centered mounting slot, a side circular control/button area, a small side pinhole, and a vertical orange side accent slot. Show the dashcam upright at a clean three-quarter studio product angle so the buyer immediately understands it is a dash camera. The screen should appear dark glossy and realistic, not showing UI graphics. The road-facing lens should have subtle glass reflections and appear smaller than the body but visually prominent. Keep proportions compact: wider rectangular face than depth, rounded vertical side edges, lower cylindrical lens housing, and protruding lens module. Include only the product and its included accessories if they can be shown cleanly: Anker 2-Port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner's Manual. Accessories must be secondary and neatly arranged, not distracting from the dashcam. Product and accessories must be fully visible and centered, filling approximately 85% of the frame. Use pure white RGB 255,255,255 background with soft minimal shadows and professional studio lighting. Do not add any promotional text, overlay labels, badges, icons, feature graphics, decorative props, hands, cars, road scenes, packaging boxes, or lifestyle background. Preserve only authentic physical details visible on the product reference; do not invent new markings, colors, ports, accessories, or design elements.
